logMetrics.name: packtook_free_new_grants
logMetrics.description: Successful initial Free grants; not Auth account creations

logMetrics.name: packtook_free_duplicate_email_attempts
logMetrics.description: Verified email already received Free in another Firebase UID; pseudonymous trigger only

logMetrics.name: packtook_free_signup_capacity_denials
logMetrics.description: New Free attempts denied by global 15m/daily cap, not a billing limit

proposedAlertReview.draftRule: More than 2 denial events in a 10-minute window
More than 5 events in a 10-minute window
Daily total approaches the owner-configured new grant cap

extraRequiredMonitors: Firebase Auth new-account creations and email verification request volume (these are outside Free grant caps)
App Check enforcement/attestation failures for Customer and signup callable
Cloud Functions v2 5xx/error rate and transaction/contention failures
Cloud Run Functions invocation volume and spend
Cloud Firestore read/write rates, contention and spend
Secret Manager secret access/audit and permissions

billing.note: Alerts-only is NOT a spending hard cap. Cloud spend-cap budgets exist only for eligible services and require separate review.
